I own the land, so I will carry manure or compost from home and use family labor, but for chemical fertilizer I will keep it low because buying a full bag is hard and sometimes it comes late from the cooperative. For seed, on this kind of other plot I will stay with the seed or planting material I already know, and I will not plan for pesticide, irrigation, or hired labor unless a problem forces me later.
